root_cause.mechanism: build_game_pregame_matrix pivoted genuine shifted pregame-state columns onto a full copy of the raw games table (game_work = games.copy()). build_oof_feature_matrix then selected every numeric column on that pivoted frame whose name started with home_/away_, which swept in native games-table passthrough columns (already home_/away_-prefixed in the raw schema) alongside genuine generated features, with no way to distinguish the two by name alone.
root_cause.why_existing_banned_column_check_missed_: nfl_hybrid.features.pregame_state.build_authoritative_pregame_state already calls validate_no_banned_features, but only on each state family's pre-pivot team-long table -- at that stage no native games column has entered the frame yet. The wildcard home_*/away_* sweep that actually caused the leak happens downstream, inside build_oof_feature_matrix, on the post-pivot, family-prefixed matrix -- a stage the existing check never re-ran on.

additional_finding: The wildcard sweep also leaked home_rest_days/away_rest_days per family (2 additional native columns x 5 families = 10 more feature slots not enumerated in the original 35-name incident report, for 45 leaked feature columns total pre-fix). home_rest_days/away_rest_days are genuinely pregame-safe information (SAFE_PREGAME_METADATA), but per the Fix 3.1 provenance contract, safe native fields still require explicit approval before becoming a model feature -- none exists today, so they are correctly excluded post-fix, same as the unsafe 35.
leak_metadata_note: known_leak_count_* fields above are retained for continuity with the original incident report but are ambiguous on their own (they conflate two different categories of unapproved column). Do not rely on them in isolation -- use the three unambiguous, separately-typed counts below.

predictor_count_definitions.confirmed_unsafe_predictor_count: Native target/postgame/current-market columns confirmed leaked pre-fix (7 native columns x 5 state families: home_score, away_score, home_moneyline_reference, away_moneyline_reference, home_spread_reference, home_spread_price_reference, away_spread_price_reference).
predictor_count_definitions.safe_but_unapproved_passthrough_count: Native columns that are pregame-safe (SAFE_PREGAME_METADATA) but reached the pre-fix feature set with no explicit approval step (2 native columns x 5 state families: home_rest_days, away_rest_days). Pregame-safe is a necessary, not sufficient, condition for being a model feature under the Fix 3.1 provenance contract.

native_passthrough_audit.ambiguous_column_note: home_qb_id/home_qb_name/away_qb_id/away_qb_name (and their away_ counterparts) are conservatively classified UNSAFE_TARGET_OR_POSTGAME: their nflverse source ingestion timing/finality relative to each game's own pregame cutoff was not independently verified during this audit, so they are treated as unsafe pending a dedicated availability-timestamp audit -- consistent with the observed-weather columns' existing treatment.
native_passthrough_audit.audit_scope: All 61 native columns on the real backfill-2020-2025 season=2023 games table (src/nfl_hybrid/data/providers/nflverse.py-produced schema plus Spreadspoke-enrichment columns from src/nfl_hybrid/data/reconcile.py), not only the 35 previously-confirmed names.

mechanism: declared_state_family_columns(state) returns exactly the state family's OWN pre-pivot output columns (state.columns minus IDENTIFIER_COLUMNS) -- the same set pregame_state.py's cross-family validate_no_banned_features already checked before this function ever sees it.

build_game_pregame_matrix(games, state, carrier_columns=()) is called with an empty carrier-column set for the OOF path specifically, so the pivot's own native-games base carries nothing but join keys -- no native column is even present to be mistaken for a feature. Per the API hardening pass below, carrier_columns now defaults to () (not None/full-native-row) for every caller, including augmented_matrix.py and opponent_pregame.py, which pass carrier_columns=() explicitly for self-documentation even though it now matches the default.
Feature selection keeps only pivoted columns in {f'home_{c}' for c in declared} | {f'away_{c}' for c in declared} -- never every column starting with home_/away_.
validate_no_banned_features(feature_columns) runs a second time on the final, family-prefixed names as defense-in-depth.

compute_feature_provenance(feature_columns) derives {feature_name, state_family, source_feature, side, availability_semantics} for every feature directly from this same naming convention, so provenance cannot drift out of sync with the matrix.
architectural_repair.why_a_new_raw_column_cannot_silently_bec: Feature selection is driven entirely by each state family's own declared output-column set, established before any pivot happens and independently checked by validate_no_banned_features. A newly added raw games column is never a member of that declared set (state-family builders only emit columns they explicitly compute), so it can never enter the allowlist regardless of its name. Even if a future change re-widened build_game_pregame_matrix's carrier_columns for the OOF path, the allowlist step alone would still exclude it.

api_hardening_2026_08_20.summary: Final API/provenance hardening pass, applied after the architectural_repair above already shipped. Closes the residual gap left by that repair: build_game_pregame_matrix's own DEFAULT was still an unrestricted native-row copy (carrier_columns=None), so any future caller that omitted carrier_columns -- not just the OOF path, which already opted in to carrier_columns=() -- would silently get the full raw games row again. This pass makes the safe behavior the default, not merely an opt-in.
api_hardening_2026_08_20.final_signature: def build_game_pregame_matrix(games: pd.DataFrame, team_pregame: pd.DataFrame, *, carrier_columns: Sequence[str] = ()) -> pd.DataFrame
api_hardening_2026_08_20.none_semantics: carrier_columns=None is accepted and treated identically to carrier_columns=() (never as "all columns"); documented explicitly in the function's docstring and covered by tests/test_pregame_rolling.py::test_none_carrier_columns_behaves_identically_to_default and tests/test_oof_feature_provenance.py::test_native_carrier_columns_never_reach_the_pivot_when_narrowed.
